record.question: By Doctrine of Lapse, Lord Dalhousie annexed a number of Indian states. By Doctrine of Lapse, Indian states were annexed because
options: if the ruler of a protected state died without natural heir and if the adopted heir was not recognized by the English government
if the ruler of a protected state died without making any official decree of his successor
if the state was already under the protection of the English, his state must passed to the English whether there were heir or not.
